# Aptivance

> Aptivance is a practical learning community in Puducherry, India. It helps learners build industry-relevant technology skills through courses, hands-on practice, mentorship, and information about internship opportunities.

Website: https://aptivance.com/
Email: hello@aptivance.com
Phone: +91 944 335 6858
Address: 8, First Floor, First Cross Street, Puducherry, India 605004

## Overview

Aptivance focuses on learning by doing. Its programmes are designed to help learners gain practical experience, build confidence, and prepare for technology careers. The website presents more than 20 courses, a community of 50+ learners, and information about 10+ internship opportunities.

## Learning Approach

- Practical, project-based learning focused on real-world skills.
- Guidance from mentors, peers, and industry experts.
- Career-readiness support for learners building technology skills.
- Course and internship enquiry support through the website contact section.

## Featured Courses

- **Android Development** — 12-week course. The listed instructor is Trisha Leo.
- **iOS Development** — 8-week course. The listed instructor is Sarah Johnson.
- **Full-stack MERN Development** — 16-week course. The listed instructor is Mike Chen.
- **Flutter** — 6-week course. The listed instructor is Emma Davis.

## Learning Areas

- Android Development
- iOS Development
- Full-stack MERN Development
- Flutter
- React Native
- AI Agent Development

## Values

- **Practical Learning:** Hands-on projects and real-world practice.
- **Supportive Community:** Learning and growth with peers, mentors, and industry experts.
- **Career Growth:** Building skills and confidence to achieve professional goals.

## Contact and Enquiries

Prospective learners can use the website's internship enquiry section to ask about courses, learning programmes, and internship-related opportunities. Contact Aptivance by email at hello@aptivance.com or phone at +91 944 335 6858.
